 "cons": [
  "User interface can feel less polished compared to some competitors",
  "Initial setup for organizational features like collections or SSO can have a learning curve",
  "Browser extension autofill might occasionally be inconsistent or messy"
 ],
 "overall_experience": "This Systems & Network Administrator likely found Bitwarden to be a highly secure and cost-effective solution for managing passwords across their mid-market organization. They appreciated its cross-platform compatibility and robust features for team collaboration, such as shared collections and SSO integration. While recognizing that the UI might lack some polish and initial setup could be complex, the overall value and security benefits outweighed these minor frustrations."
